implementation: User clarified RAR contains MDX/MDD, not only the YiDu JSONL manifest format.
RAR4/RAR5 including solid archives decode offline in a bounded Worker using libarchive-wasm 1.2.0; independent header and payload CRC validation supplements decoder finalization.

MDict parser adapts Feng Dihai MIT source with MIT lzo1x 1.0.1, RIPEMD-128 and Bluebird: bounded reads, checksums, cross-block records, exact final-key sizes, finite alias links, metadata probes. Upstream GPL minilzo is not used.

Original MDX/MDD Files are committed atomically in existing resource stores; lazy block queries run in bounded Worker cache. Direct MDX, subsequent matching MDD, ZIP and RAR all use the existing resource manager.

Text-only HTML sanitization uses an inert template, does not execute dictionary scripts or load remote assets; local MDD raster images and MP3/WAV/OGG are read on demand. Explicit pronunciation packs retain priority, with MDD and existing speech fallback.
Android SAF suffix/MIME/file-size classification includes RAR/MDX/MDD; local WASM MIME and narrowly scoped CSP WASM/Worker permissions added. No arbitrary JavaScript unsafe-eval.
Resource manager refreshes in place; standalone file import routes dictionaries to resources. Guides, labels and bounded errors are localized.
validation: 32 Chromium checks use actual WASM, compressed solid RAR5 generated from original test data, stored RAR4, raw MDX/MDD and LZO/zlib data. Verified Chinese/IPA, aliases/cycles, cross-block records, MDD image rendering and browser WAV decoding/playback, restart, disable/delete, incremental MDD, malformed/protected/volume/CRC/path rejection, encrypted indexes, nested Unicode paths, large ZIP Worker CSP, standard JSONL and global import routing.
66 core logic checks and 27 motion checks passed; 8 Java checks execute production file classification and MIME routing. Android source compiled in the signed build.

Recovered source/signature from saved files after workspace cleanup; restored pinned build/speech tools. Default browser download failed, so official Chrome headless-shell 131 was restored for testing.
Legacy EPUB fixture was absent from the previous source archive: rebuilt it from existing CC BY-NC JSON/assets, kept it test-only, retained all 27 chapters / 47 illustrations assertions.

Initial integration failures retained: RIPEMD module conversion, string .link collision, noncanonical RAR4 fixture host encoding, CRC validation gap. Fixed implementation issues and corrected only invalid fixtures; final checks all passed.
limitations: No user-supplied actual dictionary was provided; large third-party dictionaries and physical Android/WebView audio/memory behavior remain unvalidated.
RAR passwords, multi-volume archives, registered/protected dictionaries and MDict 3.x are unsupported. Common MDict 2.x and its encrypted keyword indexes are tested.
Dictionary CSS/JS and remote resources do not run. Speex/other audio codecs and exact publisher layout are not supported.
Imports probe headers/indexes and first records; later unread corrupt blocks may be detected during lookup and trigger fallback.
Previous native PDF blur and cached chapter restore acceptance items were not changed. Delta APK updates remain unimplemented.
